notes: μηδένα takes the discontinuous 'not … any' because no separate Greek negator stands in the clause, and the expressed head noun ἄνθρωπον keeps 'man'; rule 69's head on the indefinite rather than the supplied generic noun is followed.
κἀμοί handled under rule 55, taking 'and yet' along with 'unto me' as one unit headed on the pronominal; ἀλλοφύλῳ's head between 'nation' and 'another' is contested and named in its note.
